rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for fear, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.traditional: 戰亂令市民心中充滿恐懼。
example.jyutping: zin3 lyun6 ling6 si5 man4 sam1 zung1 cung1 mun5 hung2 geoi6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday verb for being afraid of something or expecting something bad with alarm.

example.english: I fear he won't make it home.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ging1 keoi5 wui5 faan1 m4 dou2 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when the fear is concern about someone's safety or welfare rather than fear of the person or thing itself.

example.english: I fear for you walking home alone at night.
example.traditional: 我擔心你一個人夜晚行返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daam1 sam1 nei5 jat1 go3 jan4 je6 maan5 haang4 faan1 uk1 kei2
